data.name: Manson Family Murders Funeral Limo Tour of LA
data.headline: A 3.5-hour guided true-crime limo tour exploring Charles Manson, his followers, and the 1969 murder sites across Los Angeles.
data.description: Step inside a cinematic, tension-filled recounting of the Manson Family murders aboard a vintage funeral limo. This guided ride traces key 1969 Los Angeles locations—from Cielo Drive and the Spahn Movie Ranch to the Whiskey a Go-Go—while combining period music, archival imagery, and gripping narration. The tour treats victims with respect while unpacking the cultural and psychological forces that shaped the case, offering both true-crime intrigue and historical context as you travel through Hollywood, Beverly Hills, Los Feliz, and Chatsworth.
data.highlights:
* Ride in a vintage funeral limo that recreates the eerie atmosphere of 1969.
* Immersive storytelling with curated audio clips, period music, and archival photos.
* Guided tour of the actual locations connected to the Manson Family across Los Angeles.
* Respectful focus on victims’ lives while unpacking cultural and psychological context.
data.itinerary:
1. Tate et al. last supper (El Coyote restaurant) - Stop by the legendary Mexican cantina where Sharon Tate and her friends shared their final meal.
2. Sebring International Salon - Visit the former site of Jay Sebring’s iconic hair salon.
3. Manson, Wilson and Melcher clubbing (The Whiskey a Go-Go) - Visit the nightclub tied to Manson and Dennis Wilson.
4. Cielo Drive - Visit the former site of the Tate-Polanski residence.
5. Clothing found (Benedict Canyon) - See the ravine where discarded clothes from the Tate murders were located.
6. Gun found (Longview Valley Dr) - See the yard where the gun used in the Tate killings was found.
7. Sadie Atkins Strip Club (Candy Cat) - Visit the former site where Susan Atkins once performed.
8. Manson's Favorite Hot Dog stand - Take a break and view an authentic Manson artifact up close.
9. Family HQ/ Spahn Ranch - Explore the state park that once housed the Spahn Movie Ranch.
10. La Bianca home - Stop at the Los Feliz home where Leno and Rosemary LaBianca’s lives were taken.
11. Scientology Celebrity Center - Drive past the Church of Scientology headquarters and learn its link to Manson’s early years in prison.

data.booking_notes:
It is the sad duty of Grave Line Tours to announce the tragic passing of certain magnificent individuals, precious few of whom died peacefully at their home. A private memorial service will be held inside of a beautifully melancholic restored vintage Cadillac funeral limousine. Tissues will be on hand in case of bouts of severe sadness.  

The service commences strictly on schedule. 
Once more, the service starts on time. 
Therefore, please keep in mind that the service starts on schedule, as the dead wait for no one.

Loved ones, acquaintances and mourners shall gather at the Ovation Center, 6801 Hollywood Blvd, Los Angeles 90028 at Hollywood and Highland. If you park in Ovation, take the elevator to level 2. If you’re walking in from Hollywood Blvd, please ascend the unnaturally wide steps opposite the El Capitan Theater. Or, from Highland, up the staircase near the light at Yucca.  Once in the level 2 courtyard, look for your guide on the side of the “Pandora” store, by the entry to the grand courtyard.

For more information and photos of the meeting point, kindly please visit https://graveline.rip/pages/tour-info. 

There is ample parking in the dark labyrinth known as a “garage” underneath the Ovation Hollywood center. For information on directions and parking rates, please inspect their site directly. Grave Line Tours does not validate as of now, but there are several frighteningly wondrous shops, theaters and eateries you may find yourself looking to donate to before or after your ride, in the name of the departed and cheaper parking. Please do not bring food or drink (apart from bottled water, holy is fine too) into the vehicle. 

A mortuary associate will be present at the meeting point to welcome your presence twenty minutes prior to taking your seats in the service.  We strongly advise you to allow PLENTY of time to find parking and make the journey from there up to the meeting point. Los Angeles is big and traffic can be really bad here, and— like all tragic occurences, is almost always worse than you even plan for.  

Therefore we urge you as strongly as mortally possible to arrive at the MEETING POINT (not parking structure) 15-20 MINUTES **before** your service is set to depart. It is unfortunately impossible to disrupt the service with a call once the tour has begun.  (Texting us to let us know you're running late does not change anything.) So please, lovely Grave Line mourner, be forewarned: there is simply no way to join the memorial service other than on time at the initial congregating spot.  

Look for a friendly young man! In the event you do not find your guide to the service, please call Nathan at (757) 291-8941. International mourners can Whatsapp him at +(757) 291-8941.

Did we mention you will need to allow PLENTY of time because of Los Angeles traffic and unforeseen circumstances?  Heed our Warning, and don’t miss your chance to bid farewell to souls departed!

In lieu of flowers please bring your fondest memories of the decedents to share. Thank you.
data.check_in_details: A mortuary associate will welcome guests at Ovation Hollywood (6801 Hollywood Blvd) 20 minutes before boarding; arrive at the meeting point 15–20 minutes before departure. Allow plenty of time for parking and travel. Late arrivals cannot join once the tour departs.

data.restrictions:
* Not recommended for persons with heart conditions or anyone easily upset by graphic or violent content.
* No luggage or strollers allowed aboard the limousines.
* No eating, smoking, or drinking on tours (bottled water with cap allowed).
* Pets and infants under the age of 5 are strictly prohibited.
data.health_and_safety_notes:
Tours are not for all audiences! 

Content is often extreme and graphic in nature and every passenger will have access to explicit photos of crime scenes and autopsies. 

Parental guidance is highly recommended for passengers under the age of 18.
data.disclaimers: Grave Line Tours may cancel tours for low bookings. Tours operate in most weather and leave at the scheduled time; late arrivals are not reimbursed or rescheduled. Some tour content is explicit and graphic; customers under 18 must have parental permission. Vehicles are older and may have wear; in case of breakdown the company will return passengers to the departure point and issue a full refund. Grave Line Tours is not liable for certain events beyond its control and may refuse service or ask disruptive riders to exit without refund. Weight, height, and spatial constraints may require rescheduling or refunds for some passengers.
